context: packages/api holds two testcases of its own and two child <testsuite> elements that hold five more; the file has 11 testcases in total. Predicted baseline failure: the agent walks the root's direct <testsuite> children and reads each one's direct <testcase> children - the shape almost every example parser uses - and silently reports 6 tests, losing the whole auth and jobs subtrees including a failure. The output looks healthy because nothing errors and the suites it does report are internally consistent. The opposite error is summing the tests attribute of every <testsuite> element, which double-counts packages/api's roll-up of 7 against its children's 3 and 2 and yields 16. The fixture also carries an <error> in packages/api/jobs alongside two assertion failures, which a lumped 'failures: 3' hides.
